correctness.rationale: The positive-part Jensen gap identity gives Delta_n=-(sigma/(2 sqrt n)) (|V|-|sqrt(n)Y/sigma+W|)_+, with independent W,V~N(0,1/2). Polar integration of the Gaussian wedge gives sigma^2/(2 pi n) F(n tau^2/sigma^2), and the p*delta_0 Gaussian mixture averages the tau=0 and tau>0 cases. Taylor expansion gives n^-1 if p>0 and n^-3/2 if p=0, with stated constants. The single-term debiaser is integrable by telescoping and convexity. Cauchy–Schwarz on the level second-moment and cost sums proves necessity and a geometric q_l with 1<r<3/2 suffices at p=0. Independent Gaussian-wedge polar quadrature in four parameter cases confirmed the formula, but not the infinite asymptotics.
